notes.content: The Psychology major is designed to provide coursework and experience central to the basic understanding of the discipline. Human behavior is examined from modern and historical perspectives in both the practical and theoretical realms. The purpose of the major is to prepare students for graduate education or vocational opportunities with a mature, uniquely Christian approach. This major seeks to develop critical thinking, collaborative problem-solving skills, and an increased ability to empathize with others, benefiting students personally and professionally Helpful Resources: Majors and Information Simpson Catalog Undergrad Admissions Transfer Admission Requirements
notes.contentHtml:
The Psychology major is designed to provide coursework and experience central to the basic understanding of the discipline. Human behavior is examined from modern and historical perspectives in both the practical and theoretical realms. The purpose of the major is to prepare students for graduate education or vocational opportunities with a mature, uniquely Christian approach. This major seeks to develop critical thinking, collaborative problem-solving skills, and an increased ability to empathize with others, benefiting students personally and professionally
